C. The reduced ODE, and the blow-up
blow-up times of the reduced ODE — numerical (RK4), not proved:
the constant mode is the slowest of the four; the more shells carry the profile, the sooner it turns over.
Why N = 3 is the smallest ring that matters
N = 1 — the minimum ring, and degenerate: there is no interior triad, so the profile is pinned to
N = 2 — the smallest ring with two genuinely distinct shells: u
N = 3 — the smallest ring with a full interior triad: shell 1 is fed by shell 0 and drained by shell
2, and the closing edge carries shell 2 back to shell 0.
so the smallest non-degenerate ring is N = 3.
everything drawn above is the N = 3 picture.
D. The honest caveats — read before believing C
N = 3, drawn: a re-derivation, not a new blow-up
The blow-up profile IS the repo's existing Cascade.selfSimilar, re-derived in log coordinates — not a new blow-up.
is periodic, so the lattice sum diverges; H = Σ
is a per-period density, not the physical enstrophy.
The profile does not satisfy the clamp (u
q ≠ 0), so it is not a solution of the clamped model, and the clamped model's regularity is not in tension with it.
Viscosity closes the ring only at e = 0; at the physical e = 2 the ansatz is a renormalization cycle, not a symmetry.
The clamped chain is regular at every finite N; blow-up requires N = ∞; the ring is the self-similar closure, and the singularity lives in the weights rather than in the nonlinearity.
